mathematics.assertion_tested: The exponential-AQUAL constant-external-field linearization has the stated coordinate-free point-source first-Born impulse, transversality, principal and generic-azimuth factors, misalignment bound, and small-angle cross-section; its z=0 invariant submanifold has the stated exact Kepler conics, period, hyperbolic deflection, and Rutherford cross-section.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic expressions over positive real symbols where possible; IEEE-754 binary64 for deterministic improper quadrature, finite-difference Jacobians, and SciPy DOP853 trajectories.
mathematics.conventions: +z is the external-field direction in displayed component formulas; n is a unit incoming direction; b is the Euclidean impact vector with n dot b=0; theta is the trajectory/external-field angle; impact azimuth phi is measured from the impact-plane vector perpendicular to both n and the external field; deflection components use that principal basis; positive Theta denotes the unsigned attractive deflection.
inputs: 147-case curved-path grid: q in {1.1,1.5,1.99}; theta and impact azimuth in {0,15,...,90} degrees
curved-path Born parameter h=0.002, with h=0.001 repeat at the worst grid geometry

bounds.field_regime: eta>0, mu_e>0, and max(g_internal/g_external)<<1 over the whole trajectory; eta=0 is retained only as a one-sided finite-ratio limit
bounds.generic_scattering: first Born order with h=C/(b v_inf^2)<<1 and small deflection for the differential cross-section
bounds.equatorial_scattering: exact at arbitrary deflection within the linearized EFD Green potential, provided the whole orbit, especially periapsis, stays EFD
bounds.source: point-source Green function or encounters outside the finite source size
bounds.external_field: approximately constant magnitude and direction over the encounter
bounds.curved_solver: dimensionless DOP853 with rtol=3e-12, atol=3e-13, default endpoints at 30000 impact parameters; equatorial control endpoints at 50000 impact parameters
bounds.quadrature: SciPy improper quadrature epsabs=2e-12, epsrel=2e-12, limit=300
